caption: The drawing depicts a carved figure of a person standing on a pedestal. The figure is adorned with a feathered headdress, primarily teal in color with some dark blue and a red band at the base. The person has brown skin and black hair that extends over their shoulders. They are dressed in a red outfit trimmed with yellow, with additional blue and yellow accents in a sash draped over one shoulder and crossing at the waist. The figure’s right arm is bent at the elbow, with the hand held above the eyes as if shading them, while the left arm is bent downward, holding a bundle (possibly tobacco leaves or a similar item) against their side. The pedestal is rectangular and tapering, colored in reddish-brown with a yellow panel on the front, and it rests on four small dark wheels. The background is a plain, light beige color. The drawing is signed "harry king k.c. mo" in the bottom right corner.
title: Cigar Store Indian
